name: Hyperion
description: Europe's tallest lift hill coaster soaring 77 metres at 142 km/h. An Intamin hyper coaster delivering breathtaking drops and airtime.

name: Zadra
description: The world's largest hybrid wooden roller coaster reaching 63 metres with thrilling drops, inversions and RMC engineering.

name: Speed
description: A launched roller coaster blasting riders to 121 km/h across 62 metres of height with three inversions and intense G-forces.

name: Mayan
description: A smooth Vekoma suspended looping coaster with five inversions, a 33-metre drop and 80 km/h delivering intense G-forces.

name: Dragon RMF
description: Poland's first inverted roller coaster racing 453 metres at 76 km/h with a 20-metre drop and thrilling tunnels.

name: Space Booster
description: A thrilling launched coaster reaching 62 metres at 121 km/h with three heart-stopping inversions in a space themed setting.

name: Abyssus
description: A dive coaster plunging riders into an underground abyss with a beyond-vertical drop and intense water effects.

name: Aztec Swing
description: A massive 27-metre diameter giant pendulum ride swinging in a sweeping arc in the Extreme zone delivering intense height and speed.

name: Jungle Adventure
description: One of Poland's largest river rapids rides navigating heart-pounding currents and thrilling swirls through an intense jungle setting.

name: Atlantis
description: An exciting water ride through the sunken city of Atlantis with dramatic story elements and a soaking final splash.

name: Formula
description: A Vekoma launched coaster racing through a high-speed track with twists and turns inspired by Formula racing.

name: Wonder Wheel
description: A towering 53-metre Ferris wheel with 30 cabins offering stunning panoramic views across the entire park and surrounding landscape.

name: Choco Chip Creek
description: A charming mine train roller coaster winding through 1.2 kilometres of candy-themed Sweet Valley scenery perfect for families.

name: Boomerang
description: A classic Vekoma boomerang coaster launching riders forwards and backwards through a cobra roll and loop at 75 km/h.

name: Apocalypto
description: A thrilling free-fall tower drop ride plunging riders from a great height with stunning views before a sudden stomach-dropping descent.
